title: Letter From British Consulate-General Re Restaurant Yagodka

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No 4829
D. 19.7.33

July 19 33.

Dear Barton,

With reference to your letter of May 2,
1933, regarding a restaurant called the YAKODA CAFE
in the French Concession, I forward herewith a copy
of a report made by Det. Sergeant Prokofiev of the
Special Branch giving the result of his inquiries
concerning this establishment.

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

1933年7月19日。

亲爱的巴顿：

关于您1933年5月2日来信，提及法租界内一家名为“YAKODA CAFE”的餐馆，现随函附上特别科普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）警佐所作报告副本一份，该报告载明了其针对该场所进行调查的结果。

此致

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE B. REGISTRY File No 14829 SECTION 2 11/33）
Date July 18, 1933

Subject (in full) Letter from British Consulate-General re: Restaurant
" YAGODKA".

Made by D.S.Prokofiev. Forwarded by （手写签名）

With reference to the letter dated May 2,1933 from
H.B.M. Consulate-General on the subject of the restaurant
" YAGODKA" ,No 240 Avenue du Roi Albert which,it is suspected, is
used as a meeting place by a certain " agents provocateurs",
I have to report that general observation has been kept on the
above place for the past two months,but apart from groups of
young men-recent arrivals from Harbin- who occasionally visited
the restaurant and attracted attention by their keeping apart
from other visitors,nothing of a suspicious or unusual nature
has been noticed.

Enquiries show that the restaurant in question has
been in existence for about two years and is licenced by the
French Municipal Council. It is kept by a Russian speaking Chi-
nese cook believed to have come in Shanghai either from Harbin
of Vladivostok. The restaurant is of a very low class and ,like
a number of other similar small restaurants in the French Con-
cession, caters for Russians of very small means ( the price of
dinner being $ 0.40 small money). It also patronized by a few
Chinese of the student type.

Like any other public place this restaurant may be
occasionally visited by various undesirables,but on the whole it
does not seem to be a suitable place for regular meetings of
" agents provocateurs":- the two tiny rooms on the ground floor
occupied by the restaurant, one of which is open to public view,
offer no privacy and conversation is liable to be overheard. The
bulk of the patrons of the re-taurant being " White" Russians,it
is almost certain that suspicious behaviour or activity will
be noticed and reported.
A. Prokofiev

（批：Ma Yao D.S. Copy Attn B. please）
Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局 B. 登记处 档案号 14829 第2部分 1933年11月）
日期：1933年7月18日

主题（全称）：英国总领事馆关于“YAGODKA”餐馆的来信。

由 D.S. Prokofiev 撰写。转发人：（手写签名）

关于英国驻华总领事馆于1933年5月2日就阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）240号“YAGODKA”餐馆一事所发信函，信中怀疑该处被某些“挑衅代理人”（agents provocateurs）用作集会地点，本人谨报告称，在过去两个月内已对上述地点进行了一般性监视，但除了一些近期从哈尔滨抵达的年轻男子群体——他们偶尔光顾该餐馆，并因与其他顾客保持距离而引人注意外，未发现有可疑或异常性质的情况。

经查询，该餐馆已存在约两年，并持有法国公董局颁发的执照。经营者是一名讲俄语的中国厨师，据信是从哈尔滨或符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）来到上海的。该餐馆档次极低，与法租界内其他许多类似的小餐馆一样，主要服务于经济拮据的俄国人（晚餐价格为小洋0.40元）。此外，也有少数学生模样的中国人光顾。

像任何其他公共场所一样，各种不受欢迎的人可能会偶尔光顾这家餐馆，但总体而言，它似乎并不适合作为“挑衅代理人”定期集会的地点：该餐馆占据底楼的两间小房间，其中一间对公众视线开放，毫无隐私可言，谈话容易被旁人听到。鉴于该餐馆的大多数顾客是“白俄”，任何可疑行为或活动几乎肯定会被察觉并举报。
A. Prokofiev

（批注：Ma Yao 警佐 抄送 特别科 请知悉）
特别科主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. S. S. B. REGISTER
N. D. H 829
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 259. SHANGHAI.
2nd May 1933.

My dear Nivens,

I have been informed that there is a restaurant
called the YAKODA CAFE in Frenchtown which is known to be the
rendezvous for a certain group of persons who have escaped from
the U.S.S.R. It is suspected, however, that a certain number
of these are acting as agents provocateurs. It might be worth
looking into.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]

T. J. Nivens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

D. S. Bakofei.
SBR 8/5.
Sg, For discreet inquiry
and report please
[Signature]
R.W.

上海公共租界
C. S. S. B. 登记处
N. D. H 829
英国总领事馆，
上海邮政信箱 259 号。
1933年5月2日。

亲爱的尼文斯：

我获悉，在法租界有一家名为“YAKODA CAFE”的餐馆，众所周知，那里是一群从苏联逃脱人员的聚会地点。然而，有人怀疑其中有一定数量的人员充当挑衅代理人（agents provocateurs）。此事或许值得调查。

此致

敬礼
[签名]

T. J. Nivens 先生，
特别科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

D. S. Bakofei.
SBR 8/5.
SG，请进行秘密调查
并提交报告
[签名]
R.W.
